answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 162396 Country: india Title: Feeling scared and confused Question: I am currently working in Bangalore for the past six days I feel very scared and confused and I am getting a feel of home please tell me some dua to cure this I just started to work so I will not be able to take leave. Please respond soon. Answer ID: 162396 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1202/1001/N=11/1439) Keep on reading istighfar and durood sharif extensively. In-shaAllah, your problems and confusion will go away and you will feel comfortable with your work. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
